items.title: Five Dividend Stocks Crushing Inflation With Consistent Dividend Payout Growth
items.summary: A static dividend yield quietly loses ground every month inflation climbs, but five companies have been raising their payouts fast enough to fight back. The question is which ones have the cash flow to keep doing it.

items.title: Automatic Data Processing Inc's Dividend Analysis
items.summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus.  Automatic Data Processing Inc (NASDAQ:ADP) recently announced a total dividend of $1.70 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-11.  As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.

items.title: 2 Large-Cap Stocks for Long-Term Investors and 1 We Find Risky
items.summary: Large-cap stocks have the power to shape entire industries thanks to their size and widespread influence. With such vast footprints, however, finding new areas for growth is much harder than for smaller, more agile players.
